name: Bauernhof Wolf
beschreibung: The Bauernhof Wolf farm is situated on the quiet edge of town, surrounded by verdant meadows with effortless access to alpine hiking trails. Run as a dedicated family business, the estate beautifully combines rural agricultural traditions with comfortable lodging. Guests stay in straightforward, neatly furnished rooms or spacious holiday apartments. A lively farmstead with animals is part of the authentic experience. In the morning, a delicious breakfast with regional products provides the perfect start to an active day.
